title: Universal Pipeline Stage
description: CRM-agnostic canonical deal-stage schema. Every CRM names its stages differently; this is the normalized shape other tools (dashboards, scoring skills, reporting) can build against without caring whether the source is Salesforce, HubSpot, or Pipedrive.

deal_id.description: The deal/opportunity ID in its source CRM.

native_stage.description: The exact stage name/label as it appears in the source CRM, unmodified.

canonical_stage.description: The normalized stage bucket. See canonical-stages.json for what each bucket means.

probability.description: Optional win probability, 0-100, if the source CRM provides one.

mapped_via.description: Whether this mapping used the shipped default-mappings.json for the source CRM, or a custom mapping the caller supplied. Real orgs almost always customize their pipeline, so 'custom' should be the common case in production use.
